What Is ALYVE

ALYVE is a social drink built from plant terpenes, the same things that give citrus, pine and fresh herbs their smell. All natural, from plants we can name, with no alcohol in it. Bring it to the dinner, the party, or the long weekend that refuses to end. Kicks in fast, and wears off clean.

Something you feel

That first easy exhale. Your shoulders drop, the room opens up, and you stay in charge of the night.

Plants you already know

Food-grade terpenes from citrus, pine and herbs, already in what you eat.

Wears off clean

The morning is still yours. No fog, no write-off, nothing to make up for.

Go out. Stay yourself.

A whole generation is drinking less, and not because they stopped going out. They just stopped wanting what alcohol costs them. ALYVE is what we built for that. A drink made from plants you can name, with a feeling you actually notice, and hands the next morning back to you.

The bar we set.

It had to be felt.

A drink you can't feel is just a story printed on a can. Ours you notice, and actually feel.

It had to keep you sharp.

The point is to be more in the room, not less. Clear head, steady hands, your own night.

It had to leave quietly.

It lets go on its own. Nothing to plan around, nothing to shake off.

From plants you can name.

Terpenes are the compounds a plant makes to give itself a smell. Crack an orange peel, crush a basil leaf, walk past lavender: that first rush of scent is terpenes, doing the job they're good at.

You've been eating them your whole life without the word for it. They're in your orange juice, your mango, the basil on your table, the pine on your street. Food-grade, long studied, nothing exotic.

So that's where we started. All natural, from plants you already know, with a feeling you can actually notice and still steer. If we can't name the plant it came from, it doesn't go in the can.

Questions, answered.

What is in it?

Thirty-nine food-grade, plant-derived terpenes, the kind used in flavor and aroma work, plus water and natural flavor. They come to 2.5 to 5 mg a serving, well under our 15 mg ceiling, and less than 0.1% of what is in the can. Real compounds, blended at trace amounts, which is all it takes.

What does it feel like?

It lands somewhere between five and twenty minutes, and eases off over the next hour or two. Bright and easygoing rather than heavy, and easy on the next morning. It gives you the ritual and the lift of a drink in your hand. It will not taste or behave like alcohol, because there is no alcohol in it.

How many can I have?

That is your call. It is a plant-derived drink rather than a measured dose, so treat it the way you would treat any drink and go by how you feel.

What does it taste like?

Our first three flavors. Mojito is cool mint and bright lime, Berry is a melody of wild berries, and Tropical is golden mango with sweet pineapple. More are on the way.

Where can I buy it?

Nowhere yet. You can preorder now, which costs nothing today and holds your place. We'll email you the moment checkout opens, and nothing gets charged before then. Leave your email and we'll tell you as soon as you can find it on a shelf near you.
